name: ring-home-manager-ios
description: Native iOS shell for Ring Home Manager (Capacitor). Bundles the web app and adds push for events that need attention.

scripts.setup: npm run prepare-www && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#0A7AEB' --splashBackgroundColor '#F3F5F8' && npx cap sync ios
scripts.update: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync ios
